headline: Timken India Limited: Updates
sum: Updates — In furtherance to our earlier communication dated 18 May, 2026 regarding Amalgamation ofTimken GGB Technology Private Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary) with the Company, wewrite to inform you that National Company Law Tribunal…
detail: Updates — In furtherance to our earlier communication dated 18 May, 2026 regarding Amalgamation ofTimken GGB Technology Private Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary) with the Company, wewrite to inform you that National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has accepted first motionapplication for Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Timken India Limited and Timken GGBTechnology Private Limited and the Company is now in the process of submitting secondmotion application to NCLT.Copy of the Order received from NCLT is available on the Company s website athttps://www.timken.com/en-in/investors/statutory-compliances/.You are kindly requested to take note of above.
